commit.message:
fix(browser): self-release system-detected rollovers (D-K8 dead approveRollover)

Live follow-up (2026-09-19, build 35427727041.1): the D-K7
COMPOSER_UNCLEARABLE rollover fired correctly but parked forever in
ROLLOVER_DEFERRED — approveRollover, the only DEFERRED -> REQUIRED
transition, has NO caller anywhere in the codebase. Every rollover
request was a terminal parking state.

requestRollover now accepts { autoRelease } and goes straight to
ROLLOVER_REQUIRED with a recorded release timestamp. ONLY the
system-detected COMPOSER_UNCLEARABLE_DK7 reason passes autoRelease —
its evidence is our own command-outcome stream (trusted class), not
page text. The page-derived CHATGPT_CONVERSATION_LIMIT_HINT path
explicitly KEEPS the deferred posture: page text never auto-authorizes
an effect (supervisor-single-authority + unbounded-source contract
tests pin this invariant and pass unchanged).

Tests: D-K8 unit contract added (auto-release executes
beginRolloverAttempt; operator-class rollovers stay deferred). Full
suite 2403 pass / 0 fail / 2 skip. npm run check clean.
